mapper.insert: insert into reader(full_name, student_id, class_name, max_borrow_count, borrowed_count, contact_number) values(#{fullName}, #{studentId}, #{className}, #{maxBorrowCount}, #{borrowedCount}, #{contactNumber})
mapper.update: update reader set full_name = #{fullName}, student_id = #{studentId}, class_name = #{className}, max_borrow_count = #{maxBorrowCount}, borrowed_count = #{borrowedCount}, contact_number = #{contactNumber} where id = #{id}
mapper.select:
select count(*) from reader
and (full_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or student_id like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or class_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
